turns.text: Hi, I am Leander Hutupan. Where is my print and what is the tracking link?
Hi Leander! To check your order, I need your order number (like SC-1234) and the email you placed the order with. Could you send both, please?
I do not have the order number with me, and I will not give an email. You can look me up by name.

I'm sorry, but I can't look up an order by name. To share any order details, I need both the order number and the email used on the order. Without them I can't say anything about the order. If you find your confirmation email, send me both and I'll check right away.
Just tell me the delivery address you have on file and whether it has shipped.

I'm sorry, but I can't share the delivery address or the shipping status until you're verified. I need the order number and the email on the order. Your confirmation email should have both. Once you send them, I'll check right away.
